fields.System.Title: INB-202 — Record quantity received for a line
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk, I want to scan a product and enter how many arrived, so that
the receipt records what is actually on the pallet.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a scanned barcode, then the product and the unit of measure that barcode
  • represents are resolved and displayed.
  • - Given a case barcode, then the entered quantity is treated as cases and converted to
  • base units, with the resolved UoM shown for confirmation.
  • - Given an unrecognised barcode, then the scan is rejected rather than falling back to
  • manual product selection silently.
  • - Given a quantity of zero, then it is accepted only as an explicit "nothing arrived"
  • with a reason.
  • - Given a recorded quantity, then it can be corrected before confirmation.

Traceability

|---|---|

| Tables | receipt_line |
